articles.author: Camilo  Montoya-Galvez
articles.title: Men from Cuba and other countries describe being deported by the U.S. to a dangerous African nation: "We cannot leave" - CBS News
articles.description: The Central African Republic is one of more than 30 countries the U.S. government has convinced to accept third-country deportees arrested as part of President Trump's large-scale crackdown on illegal immigration.
